info.description: The HTTP API of the Crypto Exchange server. docs/api.md describes the conventions: the envelope, the error codes, sign-in, and the WebSocket messages. The unversioned paths of earlier releases still answer, as deprecated aliases of the paths under /api/v1.

get.description: The restrictions of a user, newest first, at most 200: every one, lifted and ended ones included, or with active=true only those that apply now. With the reasons, cases, and notes.
get.summary: List the restrictions of a user

parameters.description: The user's UUID
parameters.name: hk

parameters.description: Only the restrictions that apply now
parameters.name: active

default.description: Any other error, in the envelope with a code

post.description: Freezes the account (scope account), blocks operations on every currency (scope operation), or holds one currency (scope asset). A freeze ends every session of the user in the same transaction, so that their tokens stop working on every instance at once, and refuses sign-in with 403 account_frozen. The restriction applies until it is lifted or reaches ends_at. The reason, case, and note are never shown to the user. Audited as user.restriction_add, and each ended session as user.session_revoke with the reason account_frozen.

parameters.description: The user's UUID
parameters.name: hk

parameters.description: The restriction
parameters.name: body

409.description: not_a_user: an administrator or a deleted user

default.description: Any other error, in the envelope with a code

post.description: Ends a restriction now. A lifted freeze lets the user sign in again; the sessions it ended stay ended. With version, the lift is refused with 409 version_conflict when the restriction has changed since. A lifted restriction answers 409 already_lifted. Audited as user.restriction_lift.
post.summary: Lift a restriction of a user

post.description: Exchanges the refresh_token cookie for a new access token, and rotates the cookie. A rotated refresh token that is presented again revokes the session, except within jwt.refresh_token.reuse_grace_seconds of its rotation, when it gets a new access token and no new cookie.

post.description: After a sign-in answered 409 session_limit_reached, ends one of the listed sessions and signs in, without a new code. The challenge works once, for five minutes. get.description: Whether the process serves requests. Checks no dependency.
503 while PostgreSQL, Redis, or RabbitMQ is unavailable, or while the instance drains at shutdown.

case_ref.description: CaseRef is the reference of the case, at most 64 characters.

currency_hk.description: CurrencyHK is the held currency of an asset restriction.

ends_at.description: EndsAt, when set, ends the restriction without a lift.

note.description: Note is for administrators, at most 1000 characters.

operations.description:
Operations are the blocked operations of an operation or asset
restriction; an account freeze blocks everything and takes none.

ended_sessions.description: EndedSessions is the number of sessions that a freeze ended.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor asks for the next page. It is left out on the last page.

note.description: Note says why, for the audit log, at most 1000 characters.

version.description:
Version is the version of the currency that an update is based on.
When it is sent and the currency has changed since, the update is
refused with 409. A create may not send it.

actor_id.description: ActorID is the hk of the user or administrator.

reason.description: Reason is the code of a failure or a denial.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor asks for the next page. It is left out on the last page.

current.description: Current marks the session of the request.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor asks for the next page. It is left out on the last page.

code.description:
Code names the error of a response of status 400 or more, for
clients to act on; Message is for people and may change.

info.description: Info can hold any type of data (e.g., list or object)

request_id.description:
RequestID is the X-Request-ID of an error response, to quote when
reporting it.

version.description:
Version counts the changes of the currency. Only administrators see
it; it is 0, and left out, in public responses.

type.description: Type is the kind of contact the code was sent to.

uuid.description: UUID identifies the sign-in session, for the verification.
UUID identifies the sign-in session, for the verification.

session_id.description:
SessionID is the session to end, one of the sessions that the
refusal listed.

challenge.description: Challenge replaces a session with POST /public/auth/sessions/replace.

expires_in.description: ExpiresIn is the number of seconds the challenge can be used.

sessions.description: Sessions are the active sessions of the user, newest first.

until.description:
Until is when the restriction ends. It is absent when the restriction
has no end, or its end is not shown.

active.description:
Active is whether the restriction applies now: not lifted, and not
past its end.

action.description: Action is add, replace, or remove.

type.description:
Type is the contact to remove. For add and replace, it is taken from
Value and may be left out.

value.description: Value is the new contact, for add and replace.

verify_with.description:
VerifyWith is the verified contact that receives the code that proves
the change is the account owner's. By default, the contact that is
replaced or removed, or for add, the other contact.

account_code_sent_to.description:
AccountCodeSentTo is the verified contact that received the code of
account_code.

expires_in.description: ExpiresIn is the number of seconds the codes are valid.

new_code_sent_to.description:
NewCodeSentTo is the new contact that received the code of new_code.
It is left out for a removal.
